## CEO overview

- What is changing: Firstmate now checks active owned work at least every ten minutes and asks for attention only when progress is overdue, a decision is unanswered, or a meaningful outcome needs review.
- Why it matters: Work that quietly stalls can be recovered sooner without turning routine monitoring into repeated model calls or noisy alerts.
- Customer or business impact: Operators get timely, targeted follow-up for genuinely blocked work while healthy work, external waits, and captain-held tasks remain quiet.
- Risk and rollout: The change is bounded to existing monitoring paths, retains durable deduplication and restart recovery, and is protected by portable behavioral regressions before rollout.

## Decision needed

No decision needed. The change stays within the existing monitoring and supervision boundaries.

## Module-boundary decision

No module-boundary change is needed. The implementation extends the existing watcher and reconciliation components instead of adding a scheduler or a separate monitoring service.
